s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface
Erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Flagellate erythema on posterior neck
Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Muscle weakness with grade 4/5 strength on resisted abduction of shoulders bilaterally
key_facts: Woman in her 50s
Stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Metastases of the liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Initial improvement followed by disease recurrence
Second course of ipilimumab led to recurrence and worsening of symptoms
Elevated creatine kinase level (1088 U/L)
Elevated aldolase level (23.0 U/L)
Elevated C-reactive protein level (28.6 mg/L)
Antinuclear antibody titer 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Photodistributed erythematous eruption, Gottron's papules, and elevated creatine kinase level

shortlist.label: Polymyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated creatine kinase level, muscle weakness, and atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Temporal association with ipilimumab treatment and characteristic skin symptoms

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Association with malignant melanoma and characteristic skin symptoms

shortlist.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated creatine kinase level, muscle weakness, and absence of inflammatory myositis on biopsy

raw.rationale: The patient developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment, and the second course of ipilimumab led to recurrence and worsening of symptoms, suggesting a temporal relationship between ipilimumab and the development of dermatomyositis-like symptoms.

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: While the patient's symptoms are consistent with dermatomyositis, the temporal relationship with ipilimumab treatment suggests a drug-induced cause.

rejected.label: Polymyositis
rejected.why: The patient's muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis, which is not typical of polymyositis.

rejected.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
rejected.why: While the patient has malignant melanoma, the temporal relationship between ipilimumab treatment and the development of symptoms suggests a drug-induced cause rather than a paraneoplastic phenomenon.

rejected.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
rejected.why: The patient's muscle biopsy did not show evidence of necrotizing autoimmune myopathy, and the clinical presentation is more consistent with dermatomyositis.
